title: Qlik NPrinting Failures by Report
app: Qlik NPrinting engine and scheduler logs via UF and the NPrinting API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:nprinting status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Qlik NPrinting failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Qlik NPrinting is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Qlik NPrinting failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Qlik NPrinting are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
